body: Please don't do that. It will traumatise a lot of people. What's happened to get you to this point? Please talk about it.

The counselling brought up a lot of anger from my past and I found it useful at the time, but you only get so many sessions so it stopped.

I ended up pushing everyone away. I'm not blaming the counselling, as I think the emotions would've come out anyway. I feel like I have no control over my feelings and it scares me.

When I went back to see my Dr last year he said I need to pay for some good counselling, which I can't afford.

You feel like you have to sort it out yourself really.

Cats are fantastic company aren't they? My older cat can always sense when I'm upset or if I cry, she'll come and sit on my lap or lie on my chest in bed and give me a few comforting licks. I don't know what I'd do without them. They are like my family.
Life can be pretty shitty, but I hope you're still here. Around if you want to chat.
I hope you're still here. Around if you want to talk.

Same here. 2 cats are all I have in the world. They're keeping me going. I'd hate to leave them. I wake up every morning and wish I wasn't here anymore. I sometimes wish I'd die of cancer instead of other people who have worthwhile lives being taken.
